units.text: The WHO African Region accounted for about 95% of global malaria cases in 2024 according to the World Health Organization's World Malaria Report.

judgement.reason: The passages confirm that the WHO African Region had about 95% of malaria cases in 2024, but they do not mention the World Malaria Report, so the stated source attribution is not supported.

units.text: Another source attributed to the WHO World Malaria Report 2025 states that the WHO African Region accounts for 94% of global malaria cases in 2024.

citations.title: Malaria facts & statistics 2025 | Medicines for Malaria Venture

judgement.reason: The passage states the WHO Africa Region accounts for 94% of cases globally, but it does not attribute this to the WHO World Malaria Report 2025 or specify the year 2024.
